title_sq: Apartamente 2+1+2 ne shitje tek Color Splash Residence fundi i Bulevardit te ri ne Tirane (ID 41211612)
description_sq:
Ne Paskuqan tek Color Splash Residence shume prane Bulevardit te Ri, shitet apartament 2+1+2 me nje siperfaqe totale 115 m² . siperfaqe neto 100 m² kati 3 banim ne pallat te ri me ashensor.
Apartamenti organizohet ne nje dhjome ndenje , ambientin e gatimit me vete , dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete (njeri me dritare), ballkon dhe nje koridor lidhes me te gjitha dhomat
Cmimi 132 300 euro i diskutueshem.
title_en: 2+1+2 apartments for sale at Color Splash Residence at the end of the new Boulevard in Tirana (ID 41211612)
description_en: In Paskuqan, at Color Splash Residence, very close to New Boulevard, a 2+1+2 apartment with a total area of ​​115 m² is for sale. net area 100 m², 3rd floor residential in a new building with elevator. The apartment is organized in a living room, a separate kitchen, two bedrooms, two bathrooms (one with a window), a balcony and a corridor connecting all the rooms. Price 132,300 euros, negotiable.
